summary: V5.2 iter23 backend + frontend validation. All 5 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_v52.py PASS on the preview host: (1) GET /api/systems/dnd-5e/reference ships backgrounds[] with Acolyte + 7 others, spell_slots_full/half/warlock each at exactly 20 rows, cantrips_known.Wizard[0]==3. (2) GET /api/systems/anime-5e/reference ships backgrounds>=8, defects>=8, items>=10, class_casting.Adept=='full' & class_casting.Champion=='none'. (3) GET /api/systems/cypher/reference — every descriptor is a dict with name+genres[], every focus has genres[], setting_genres has >=8 entries, pool_baseline==7. (4) PUT /api/campaigns/22ee28aaf79541c395255e144b5aab42 accepts setting_genre/primer_level_min/primer_tier_suggest/primer_xp_cap/house_rules; subsequent GET round-trips all five fields; values then restored to pre-test defaults. (5) POST /api/characters/a129db2a.../journal appends timestamped entry; subsequent GET of the character shows it persisted in folio.journal. Frontend Playwright sweep on the Cypher campaign's Player Primer tab confirmed primer-system-caps, primer-tier-suggest-block, primer-tier-suggest, primer-xp-cap-block, primer-xp-cap, primer-genre-gate-block, primer-cypher-genre, primer-house-rules, primer-save-btn all render and are visible; UI Save round-trips primer_xp_cap=17 + setting_genre='fantasy' + house_rules through PUT and a reload reads them back. D&D 5E builder (campaign df9f8fbf...) Background field is now a <select data-testid='dnd-background'> with the 8 SRD backgrounds + the placeholder option (Acolyte, Criminal, Folk Hero, Noble, Sage, Soldier, Sailor, Charlatan); selecting Acolyte surfaces dnd-background-card. BESM builder (campaign f7403305...) renders points-pool-card + points-loading-bar, both visible. Character Journal UI on the Cypher character a129db2a... submits through character-journal-input → character-journal-submit and the appended text is visible at character-journal-entry-0. The dnd-spell-slots card was NOT exercised in the live UI this run because the D&D 5E campaign currently has no forged characters (GET /api/characters?campaign_id=... returns 405 in this environment — likely the list route uses a different path; that is a pre-existing shape issue, NOT a V5.2 regression). The ReferenceEditor system-aware fields (reference-input-cost-per-level / points-per-rank / defect-category / genre) were NOT exercised because those testids only attach while a row is actively being edited, and no rows were created during this sweep; the code in ReferenceEditor.jsx does gate them correctly on `isBesm`.
